title: Any other autistic/free-thinking people who love morally complex movies?

commenti.body: I'm on the spectrum as well and love several movies that are morally gray. Love Haneke.
bruvv how did the comment get deleted so fast? what did it say👀
It was too short. I put.... Autistic. Love Haneke 🤣

Is the implication of this question that generally autistic people generally like morally gray movies? Or at least more than non-autistic people?

My initial instict would be to say there is no corrolation, though I am open to being wrong about that.

I do not know enough about autism to build a correlation, but I asked to an Asperger friend and he says he prefers morally gray films.

I have an autistic aunt, however, and I can assure you that she prefers to watch simpler films. She mostly watch children's shows.

From my observation, autistic people with intellectual disability  like my aunt are not interested at all in complex films. 

I think it would be hard to generalize.
